visual_review: NSMD preferred; radial clearance dimension is 0.05 MAX, not MIN. SMD example has 0.05 MIN metal overlap.
finding: Zero nominal margin is supported by candidate fabricator public multilayer process. It still differs from a positive-clearance NSMD geometry and does not establish package-specific yield.
next_action: Retain current 1:1 mask pending package-specific fabrication/assembly capability and neighboring-trace clearance review; do not apply automatic mask expansion based solely on zero margin.

findings: Current capability page explicitly permits 1:1 copper-to-mask openings after June 2025 LDI upgrade.
Blog states multilayer LDI alignment within +/-0.02 mm; this is a supplier claim, not a geometric proof of zero encroachment.
Capability specifies >=0.09 mm mask-opening to neighboring trace clearance.
Dam criteria are stated as PAD spacing (0.10 mm at 1 oz standard colors), not a guaranteed final mask-web width.
Generic minimum SMD pad listing is 0.25 x 0.25 mm; U10 uses manufacturer-example 0.23 mm circular copper. Package-specific capability remains unresolved.
followup_findings: BGA-specific capability permits 0.20-0.25 mm pad diameter with ENIG. U10 0.23 mm lies within that published range; generic 0.25 mm SMD minimum is not the applicable screening limit.
Standard PCBA lists 0.35 mm minimum IC pitch; U10 0.4 mm is within this published pitch capability.
Standard PCBA supports double-sided assembly but lists minimum PCB/panel 70 x 70 mm with rails and fiducials required. The 24 x 27 mm design needs a separate assembly panel.
